"We charge them; otherwise we cannot run the hospital" front line workers, clients and health financing policy implementation gaps in Ghana. OBJECTIVES This paper examines policy implementation gaps of user fees plus exemptions and health insurance in providing financial access to primary clinical care for children under five in Ghana. METHODS Methods included analysis of routine data, focus group discussions, in-depth interviews, and administration of a structured questionnaire. RESULTS Providers modified exemptions policy implementation arrangements, sometimes giving partial or no exemptions.
